vendors.description: Qualys is a cloud-native vulnerability and compliance platform with VMDR (Vulnerability Management, Detection, and Response) as its flagship. Combines vulnerability scanning, patch management, compliance, and external attack surface management in a unified cloud agent architecture. TruRisk scoring provides risk-based prioritization.
vendors.key_differentiators: Cloud-native since inception, single lightweight agent architecture, TruRisk quantified risk scoring, integrated patch management (zero-touch patching), VMDR unifying VM/patch/compliance, broadest cloud provider coverage

Leverages Qualys Cloud Platform's global scanner infrastructure for broad internet visibility.

vendors.description: Rapid7 combines vulnerability management (InsightVM), application security testing (InsightAppSec), and penetration testing (Metasploit) in a unified cloud platform. The Command Platform unifies exposure management, detection and response, and threat intelligence. Metasploit is the world's most widely used penetration testing framework.
vendors.key_differentiators: Metasploit penetration testing framework (open source + pro), InsightVM real-risk prioritization, Command Platform unification, active risk scoring with attacker analytics, integrated DAST via InsightAppSec, strong community/open-source heritage

ASM-01.rationale: Rapid7 Surface Command provides continuous external attack surface management with internet-facing asset discovery. Enumerates exposed domains, IPs, cloud services, and shadow assets. Combines with Threat Command (formerly IntSights, acquired 2021 for $335M) for threat-informed external exposure analysis. Correlates discovered assets with dark web intelligence and brand monitoring.

VUL-02.rationale: Real Risk Score incorporates CVSS base, temporal metrics, exploit availability (Metasploit module existence), malware kit exposure, and asset criticality for contextual risk prioritization. Active threat intelligence from Threat Command enriches scoring with dark web exploit market data and threat actor targeting. Documented noise reduction of 80%+ versus CVSS-only. Risk scores update as new exploits emerge.

Cortex XSIAM integrates exposure management into the broader SOC platform. Prisma Cloud covers cloud and application security including CSPM, CWPP, and CNAPP capabilities.

ASM-01.rationale: Cortex Xpanse is a market leader in EASM, named a Leader in both Gartner MQ for External Attack Surface Management and Forrester Wave for EASM. Acquired Expanse in 2020 for $800M. Provides continuous external attack surface discovery across the entire internet, identifying assets within hours of deployment. Indexes 500+ billion data points daily across 700+ cloud service providers. Automated asset attribution links discovered assets to organizational ownership.

vendors.description: Pentera is a leader in automated security validation, delivering automated penetration testing that safely exploits real vulnerabilities across the full attack surface. The platform autonomously discovers, tests, and validates security gaps using actual attack techniques aligned to MITRE ATT&CK without agents or pre-configuration.
vendors.key_differentiators: Autonomous real-exploitation pentesting (not simulation), agentless architecture, safe exploitation without disruption, full kill-chain validation, RansomwareReady module, credential exposure testing, MITRE ATT&CK-aligned testing

ASM-01.rationale: Pentera Surface provides external attack surface discovery by identifying internet-facing assets, exposed services, and vulnerable entry points from an attacker's perspective. Agentless, outside-in scanning without requiring network access. Discovers assets through DNS enumeration, certificate transparency logs, and internet scanning. Automatically feeds discoveries into Pentera Core for exploitation validation.

vendors.description: XM Cyber is the pioneer of attack path management and continuous exposure management. The platform continuously maps all possible attack paths from any breach point to critical assets, identifying choke points where a single fix eliminates multiple attack paths. Acquired by Schwarz Group (parent of Lidl/Kaufland) in 2022.
vendors.key_differentiators: Attack path analysis pioneer, continuous exposure management graph, choke point remediation prioritization, hybrid environment coverage (on-prem + cloud + identity), founded by former Israeli intelligence leaders, quantified risk reduction metrics

ASM-01.rationale: XM Cyber provides external exposure analysis through its Continuous Exposure Management platform. Identifies internet-facing assets and correlates external exposure with internal attack paths. Not a dedicated EASM scanner — focuses on how external exposure connects to critical internal assets through attack path modeling.

DeepCode AI provides AI-powered code analysis. The platform integrates natively with IDEs, Git repositories, and CI/CD pipelines to find and fix vulnerabilities where developers work.

Proactive scanning triggers automatically when new vulnerabilities or attack surface changes are detected.

vendors.description: Censys provides continuous internet-scale attack surface management built on proprietary internet scanning data. Born from the University of Michigan research team that created the ZMap internet scanner. The platform provides the most comprehensive view of internet-connected assets and their exposures, used by both enterprises and threat intelligence teams.
vendors.key_differentiators: Internet-scale scanning data (broadest internet visibility), academic origins (ZMap creators), continuous internet scanning infrastructure, cloud connector integrations (AWS/Azure/GCP), attribution engine for unknown asset ownership, used by both ASM customers and threat researchers

ASM-01.rationale: Censys is a market leader in internet-wide attack surface visibility. Scans the entire IPv4 internet continuously. Censys Search provides the most comprehensive view of internet-connected assets. Founded by Zmap creators. Industry benchmark for EASM. University of Michigan research spinout. Internet-wide scanning pioneer.

Combines vulnerability assessment, compliance monitoring, patch management, and endpoint management in a unified agent-based architecture. Maintains one of the world's largest vulnerability intelligence databases (175,000+ checks). Strong adoption in APAC mid-market and government sectors.

vendors.description: NetSPI is the pioneer of Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS), combining 350+ in-house penetration testers with purpose-built AI to deliver continuous, human-led, AI-accelerated cybersecurity testing. Founded in 2001, NetSPI provides application, network, cloud, hardware, AI/ML, and mainframe pentesting, along with attack surface management, red team operations, social engineering, detective controls testing, and threat modeling. GigaOm Radar Leader and Outperformer for PTaaS 2025. Serves 9 of 10 top US banks, 3 of 5 largest cloud providers, and all 5 MAMAA tech giants.
